name: Matt Carr
prior_offices: Teton County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Matt Carr is the Teton County sheriff and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The Jackson Hole News&Guide reported in July 2024 that he attended the interviews when commissioners appointed Richard "Dick" Stout as county attorney. He won the November 2022 general election.

sources.name: Jackson Hole News&Guide, July 24, 2024, Longtime defender chosen as county prosecutor
